## Documentation

One special entity in a text message.

For example, hashtags, usernames, URLs, etc.

### Parameters

- **`type`** ([`MessageEntityType`](../../enums/MessageEntityType.md))
  Type of the entity.

- **`offset`** (`int`)
  Offset in UTF-16 code units to the start of the entity.

- **`length`** (`int`)
  Length of the entity in UTF-16 code units.

- **`url`** (`str`, *optional*)
  For `TEXT_LINK` only, url that will be opened after user taps on the text.

- **`user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md), *optional*)
  For `TEXT_MENTION` only, the mentioned user.

- **`language`** (`str`, *optional*)
  For "pre" only, the programming language of the entity text.

- **`custom_emoji_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  For `CUSTOM_EMOJI` only, unique identifier of the custom emoji.
  Use [`get_custom_emoji_stickers`](../../methods/messages/get_custom_emoji_stickers.md) to get full information about the sticker.

- **`collapsed`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `BLOCKQUOTE` only, whether the blockquote expandable.

- **`date`** (`int`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, the Unix time to show.

- **`relative`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, show the time relative to now.

- **`short_time`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, show the time in a short way (22:45).

- **`long_time`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, show the time in a long way (22:45:00).

- **`short_date`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, show the date in a short way (17.03.22).

- **`long_date`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, show the date in a long way
  (March 17, 2022).

- **`day_of_week`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  For `FORMATTED_DATE` only, show the day of the week.

- **`old_text`** (`str`, *optional*)
  For `DIFF_REPLACE` only, the text that was replaced.
